title: Relief, rivers and natural lakes
attribution: Made with Natural Earth. Natural Earth contributors; SRTM Plus-derived relief.
temporal_policy: Modern physical reference only, independent of historical validity. Lake shorelines, river courses and drainage can differ in the past. No settlement, political ownership or dated hydrology assertions.
display_method: Global grayscale SRTM Plus-derived relief, bilinear Mercator reprojection with area downsampling; independent Natural Earth50m physical-land tint mask. Warm land and blue water are display colors, not elevation bands. JPEG tiles are cartographic textures, not elevation values.

source_resolution.limit: Regional reference geography; no street-scale or parcel detail.
